It is created by casting [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] on a [[sapphire amulet]]. It is one of the cheapest and most common amulets in the game because of the low [[Crafting]] level to craft it, how common [[sapphire]]s are, and the low Magic level to enchant the amulet. A normal amulet of magic, as well as its [[Amulet of magic (t)|trimmed variant]] are both possible reward for the completion of easy [[Treasure Trails]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = +10 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = neck |image = [[File:Sapphire amulet equipped.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Amulet of magic equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Magic |skill1lvl = 7 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 17.5 |members = No |ticks = 3 |ticksnote = Manual casting is 3 ticks, auto-casting is 7 ticks |mat1 = Sapphire amulet |mat2 = Cosmic rune |mat3 = Water rune |output1 = Amulet of magic }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Amulet of magic}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Amulet of magic}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Amulet of magic}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 30 October 2014 |update = Target Teleport & Fedora Tip |change = Removed an incorrect use of capitalization on the examine info of the amulet of magic.
